capabilities: Honest causal, instrumental, survival and multi-arm forests
decision: R benchmark and optional governed adapter
limitation: Copyleft review and dependence assumptions precede distribution
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Numeric X,Y,W, nuisance predictions, optional sampling weights and clusters.
scientific_qualification.output: Binary-treatment CATE; for continuous W the documented local covariance/variance coefficient, with selected forest uncertainty.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Unconfounded treatment and support; forest regularity and sampling assumptions; a continuous-treatment projection is not automatically a pointwise dose derivative.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Preserve equalize.cluster.weights and sample.weights as target metadata. Equalization requires sample.weights=NULL. Record honesty and ci.group.size; the latter must be at least two for interval computation.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Two clusters of sizes 1 and 9 with effects 0 and 10 distinguish cluster mean 5 from unit mean 9; verify target metadata and weighted aggregation. Compare continuous-treatment projection with a nonlinear dose derivative.

evidence.finding: Binary/continuous estimands, sample/cluster weights, honesty, interval group size and seeds.

pinned_api_revision.scope: Inspected API files at this commit; not an assertion about all README bytes or the published package release.
